messages:
maria: opened a small PR to add an operational troubleshooting blurb: detect header-driven trims and a minimal retry+shrink pattern. need node + python snippets and a quick curl repro.

sam: paste node snippet here and i'll run snippet-lint. keep it tiny.

maria: node snippet idea:
```javascript
const r = await fetch(url, opts);
if (r.status === 429) await retryBackoff();
if (r.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim')) { shortenSystemPrompt(); await retryOnce(); }
```

kevin: i'll add python (requests) + a pytest that mocks Response.headers.

liz: please add a one-line guidance on tradeoffs: use detect-and-shrink when quality is the primary goal; proactively truncate when you have strict P95 latency. also link to errref for 429/timeout semantics.

sam: snippet-lint usually flags fence langs and trailing spaces. i'll run a preflight once it's pushed.

docs-bot: PR #554 opened by maria  reviewers: @sam @kevin; labels: docs-snippet, needs-ci.

ci-bot: snippet-lint failed for PR #554: fence lang should be "javascript"; trailing whitespace in codeblock.

maria: fixing fences + adding curl repro that hits our test harness. curl example: `curl -i -X POST $TEST_URL -d @big_prompt.json -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"` expect response header `x-rw-context-trim: true`.

kevin: once green i'll push the pytest in a follow-up PR to keep changelist scoped.

sam: will do a quick review after CI passes.

maria: thanks all  tagging @liz for final copyedit on green.
